item.name: Oak Staff
item.description: A moon-blessed staff cut from the grove beyond the walls.

item.name: Iron Dagger
item.description: A short utility blade that becomes a weapon whenever diplomacy loses patience.

item.name: Rusty Sword
item.description: A battered sword from the watch armory. It is ugly, honest, and still sharp enough.

item.name: Iron Spear
item.description: A crafted watch spear with reach, balance, and a very persuasive point.

item.name: Watch Halberd
item.description: A town-forged polearm with a hooked axe head, useful for keeping trouble at a formal distance.

item.name: Thorn Recurve
item.description: A greenwood bow grown rather than carved, its string humming with the patience of old trees.

item.name: Ember Sabre
item.description: A curved blade that leaves a brief orange line in the air after every swing.

item.name: Oasis Staff
item.description: A staff of acacia wood and glass sand, bright with contained mirage-light.

item.name: Glass Sabre
item.description: A craft-only blade of emberglass and singing sand. Its charged edge cuts like sunlight through water.

item.name: Archive Blade
item.description: A moon-etched blade that hums whenever a hidden ward considers lying.

item.name: Moonfall Scepter
item.description: A crafted scepter capped with lunar script. It focuses spells beautifully until its three charges dim.

item.name: Starless Edge
item.description: A final-zone blade with a black mirror edge. It cuts best while its three charges still hold.

item.name: Wyrmfang Lance
item.description: A lance shaped from void scale and relic-bright steel, meant for enemies too large to respect ordinary blades.

item.name: Padded Armor
item.description: Quilted armor stitched in green thread, good for surviving the first mistake.

item.name: Focus Robe
item.description: A scholar's robe sewn with tiny grounding knots that help preserve magical focus.

item.name: Leather Coat
item.description: Flexible leather reinforced for travel, climbing, and abrupt exits.

item.name: Watch Coat
item.description: A green-trimmed patrol coat with hidden padding and enough pockets for bad news.

item.name: Wild Mage Robe
item.description: A fur-lined robe that hums softly when moonlight touches it.

item.name: Chainmail
item.description: Interlocked steel rings that add enough protection to make bold plans less foolish.

item.name: Thornweave Cloak
item.description: A cloak braided from Thornwild fiber and moon ink, warm as living bark until its warding charge fades.

item.name: Miner Heatwrap
item.description: A rugged wrap of slag leather and brass buckles, standard kit for workers who cannot afford to combust.

item.name: Dune Robe
item.description: A robe woven to shed heat, grit, and small curses until its enchantment runs dry.

item.name: Cinder Mail
item.description: Blackened mail lined with ash-cloth, made for walking through heat and bad odds.

item.name: Serpentstep Jacket
item.description: A smoke-soft rogue jacket stitched with tiny crystal scales. It turns glancing blows aside until its borrowed moon-charge runs thin.

item.name: Mirage Scale Vest
item.description: A vest of pale scales and desert thread that seems to shift half an inch away from incoming blows.

item.name: Oracle Mantle
item.description: A mantle of silver panels and soft cloth, built to protect the body and organize the mind.

item.name: Lunar Guard Hauberk
item.description: Archive battle-mail etched with quiet equations that make violence arrive in a more manageable order.

item.name: Citadel Plate
item.description: Heavy plate lacquered in green and black, made for the last doors of the story.

item.name: Wyrmhide Wardcoat
item.description: A craft-only coat of void scale, sunspun thread, and old defiance. It dulls after three heavy hits but never becomes ordinary.

item.name: Iron Blade
item.description: A forged spearhead recovered from old watch stores.

item.name: Oak Haft
item.description: A straight oak shaft, sanded smooth and balanced for a spear.

item.name: Wolf Pelt
item.description: Thick grey fur from a road-stalking wolf.

item.name: Bear Pelt
item.description: Coarse brown fur warm enough to hold a little wild magic.

item.name: Glimmer Ore
item.description: Green-flecked ore that brightens when carried near old wards.

item.name: Ember Ore
item.description: Iron-veined ore warm enough to steam in the rain.

item.name: Glass Sand
item.description: Fine desert sand that rings like crystal when poured from palm to palm.

item.name: Moon Ink
item.description: Ink made from ground moonstone, useful for spells that need to remember themselves.

item.name: Void Shard
item.description: A cold black splinter from the Starless Citadel, heavy with borrowed night.

item.name: Thornheart Fiber
item.description: A resilient strand pulled from living briar, flexible until it decides not to be.

item.name: Greenwood Core
item.description: A polished heartwood rod grown in the deep Thornwild and still faintly awake.

item.name: Slag Leather
item.description: Heat-cured hide from Emberdeep harnesses, tough enough to shrug off flying cinders.

item.name: Emberglass Ingot
item.description: A transparent ingot with a coal-red heart, prized by smiths who enjoy difficult miracles.

item.name: Sunspun Thread
item.description: Gold-white thread traded across Vel'rasha, warm in the hand and stubborn in a weave.

item.name: Star Salt
item.description: Crystalline salt gathered where mirages collapse, used to keep enchantments from drifting sideways.

item.name: Lunar Page
item.description: A salvaged page of silver vellum that remembers the last spell written on it.

item.name: Silver Quill Nib
item.description: A precise archive nib, sharp enough to draw ink through warded parchment.

item.name: Wyrm Scale
item.description: A dark scale from a citadel serpent or worse, edged with a cold that refuses daylight.

item.name: Silver Ring
item.description: A bright ring that steadies the wearer's timing in a fight.

item.name: Warding Pendant
item.description: A moon-silver pendant that layers a small ward around the heart.

item.name: Hunter Band
item.description: A practical charm worn by scouts who expect both pursuit and retaliation.

item.name: Guardian Band
item.description: A refined band that joins watchcraft and archive wards into one steadying circuit.

item.name: Nimble Fingers Ring
item.description: A thin ring with a moonstone notch that steadies careful hands near purses, pins, and stubborn locks.

item.name: Sunward Charm
item.description: A warm charm from caravan wardens who believe courage should be portable.

item.name: Ember Focus Ring
item.description: A brass ring set with a coal-bright chip that turns impatience into cleaner strikes.

item.name: Shadow Hasps
item.description: Tiny black cuff-clasps that keep sleeves, nerves, and suspicious attention from moving too loudly.

item.name: Oasis Breath Charm
item.description: A blue-glass charm that makes dry air feel kinder and dangerous air feel negotiable.

item.name: Moon Index Ring
item.description: A ring that keeps one tiny moonlit library indexed around the wearer's knuckle.

item.name: Scribe Lens Pin
item.description: A lapel pin fitted with a rotating lens, perfect for reading tiny runes and enormous implications.

item.name: Voidward Pendant
item.description: A pendant that beats like a second cautious heart near the Starless Citadel.

item.name: Concord Seal Band
item.description: A craft-only relic band that harmonizes thorn, ember, mirage, moon, and void into one dangerous little circle.

item.name: Healing Tonic
item.description: A red herbal tonic that knits bruises and shallow cuts.

item.name: Mana Tonic
item.description: A cool blue drink that clears spell-fog from the mind.

item.name: Fury Draught
item.description: A pepper-red draught that makes every swing arrive half a heartbeat sooner.

item.name: Guard Tonic
item.description: A chalky tonic that turns fear into a steadier guard.

item.name: Antidote
item.description: A bitter green vial that pulls venom out of the blood before it can settle in.

item.name: Mana Crystal
item.description: A thumb-sized crystal that stores enough clean mana to wake a depleted enchantment.

item.name: Greater Healing Tonic
item.description: A stronger red tonic reserved for deep-zone expeditions and anyone bleeding in an impressive way.

item.name: Greater Mana Tonic
item.description: A clear blue draught that washes fatigue from the mind like rain from slate.

item.name: Stoneskin Phial
item.description: A gritty gray phial that briefly convinces your bones they are architecture.

item.name: Ironwill Draught
item.description: A bitter black draught that steadies the guard hand and sharpens the striking hand at once.

item.name: Springwater Vial
item.description: A sealed vial from Vel'rasha's moonlit spring, soothing both cracked skin and frayed focus.

item.name: Iron Pry Bar
item.description: A short forged bar with a hooked lip, made for opening stuck grates, old crates, and bad ideas.

item.name: Lockpicks
item.description: A roll of slim picks and tension wires for quiet doors, nervous locks, and choices best made quickly.

item.name: Watch Token
item.description: A stamped wooden token used to identify Watch allies and wake old signal lanterns along the north road.

item.name: Archive Cipher
item.description: A folded strip of moon-script used to translate whispering ore, sealed marginalia, and other Archive-minded inconveniences.

item.name: Ember Pump Gear
item.description: A brass gear with heat-blackened teeth, meant to wake the old mine pumps.

item.name: Desert Compass
item.description: A moonlit compass that points toward water, shade, and occasionally trouble.

item.name: Field Trowel
item.description: A narrow trowel carried by rangers for digging seed caches, old trail markers, and the occasional boot free.

item.name: Heatproof Gloves
item.description: Thick gloves lined with slag leather, made for touching mine machinery that strongly prefers not to be touched.

item.name: Moon Calipers
item.description: Silver calipers that measure script spacing, relic fractures, and the distance between a good idea and a curse.

item.name: Void Tuning Fork
item.description: A black iron fork that rings without sound, useful for finding where citadel wards are pretending to be walls.

item.name: Rubbing Kit
item.description: Charcoal sheets, wax, and a flat brush for copying inscriptions that would rather not travel.

item.name: Sunfire Codex
item.description: A lacquered spellbook whose pages glow like banked coals.

item.name: Veil Manual
item.description: A compact guide to layered defensive wards and very patient handwriting.

item.name: Root Mender Primer
item.description: A ranger's annotated primer on persuading wounds to close with Thornwild stubbornness.

item.name: Stormchain Codex
item.description: A lacquered archive codex that smells like rain on hot stone and refuses to stay shut during storms.

item.name: Quietus Glimmer Notes
item.description: A loose packet of rogue marginalia written in ink visible only when nobody is looking directly at it.

item.name: Starless Aegis Treatise
item.description: A dangerous treatise copied from citadel armor plates, teaching a ward that learned endurance from darkness.

item.name: Vault Key
item.description: A bronze key with a crescent tooth and the Archive's old seal on its bow.

item.name: Exchange Vault Key
item.description: A green-glass key stamped with the exchange office seal. It opens Marlow's private vault door.

item.name: Smithy Cellar Key
item.description: A wrought iron key covered in soot. It opens the padlock on the cellar door in the Smithy

item.name: Archive Supply Key
item.description: A silver key capped with a crescent moon, the mark indicates it opens the supply room.

item.name: Warded Stacks Key
item.description: A slim archive key cut from white metal, warm only when pointed toward ink that bites.

item.name: Moon Sigil
item.description: A cold silver disk etched with the heartward's central glyph.

item.name: Heart Lantern
item.description: A green glass lantern meant to carry a living spark into the heart of the keep.

item.name: Thorn Crown Relic
item.description: A living crown of green briar and old oath-magic. It pulses when carried near the final gate.

item.name: Emberheart Relic
item.description: A fist-sized coal that never cools, wrapped in a lattice of black crystal.

item.name: Mirage Orb Relic
item.description: A glassy orb full of moving desert light, showing roads that may not exist yet.

item.name: Moonfall Relic
item.description: A shard of fallen moonstone etched with the last complete heartward equation.

item.name: Faded Keepsake
item.description: A small ribbon-bound keepsake with a pressed emerald leaf inside. It feels too personal to sell and too deliberate to ignore.

item.name: Pip's Lucky Button
item.description: A brass coat button polished smooth by nervous thumbs. Pip swears every good road starts with it in his pocket.

item.name: Lost Watch Badge
item.description: A dented badge from a patrol that vanished beyond the thorn line.

item.name: Broken Astrolabe
item.description: A bent brass astrolabe that still points toward impossible constellations.

item.name: Archive Tablet
item.description: A clay tablet packed with tiny script from a sealed wing of the Moonfall Archive.

item.name: Citadel Map
item.description: A charcoal map of the Starless Citadel's outer halls, drawn by someone who was running.

item.name: Ranger Field Notes
item.description: A weatherproof booklet full of practical trail marks, thorn sketches, and one excellent drawing of an angry squirrel.

item.name: Miner Tally Stone
item.description: A flat black stone scratched with Emberdeep shift marks, carried by miners to remember who came back up.

item.name: Oasis Story Shell
item.description: A small shell from a desert spring, somehow holding the sound of water under moonlight.

item.name: Curator Seal Wax
item.description: A moon-silver stick of seal wax used by the Archive for messages that should arrive unchanged.

item.name: Naeve's Broken Lantern
item.description: A cracked green lantern from Scout Naeve's first citadel run, still smelling faintly of smoke and bad timing.

recipe.name: Iron Spear Pattern
recipe.description: A watch forge pattern for fitting an iron blade to an oak haft.

recipe.name: Guardian Band Pattern
recipe.description: An archive jeweler's pattern for braiding attack timing, defense wards, and endurance into one band.

recipe.name: Wild Mage Robe Pattern
recipe.description: A field tailor's pattern that needs two wolf pelts and one bear pelt to hold the wild magic evenly.

recipe.name: Ember Sabre Pattern
recipe.description: A heat-forge pattern for turning common steel into a blade fit for Emberdeep.

recipe.name: Oasis Staff Pattern
recipe.description: A star-carver's pattern that fixes mirage-light into a useful weapon.

recipe.name: Archive Blade Pattern
recipe.description: An archive weapon pattern written as both a recipe and a warning.

recipe.name: Citadel Plate Pattern
recipe.description: A final armoring pattern that binds steel, void, and stubborn survival together.

recipe.name: Thornweave Cloak Pattern
recipe.description: A ranger's pattern for weaving living briar fiber into a cloak that bends blows aside.

recipe.name: Glass Sabre Pattern
recipe.description: A desert-smith pattern that quenches emberglass in ringing sand until the edge keeps its own light.

recipe.name: Moonfall Scepter Pattern
recipe.description: An archive focus pattern that turns salvaged pages and silver scriptwork into a spellcaster's weapon.

recipe.name: Wyrmfang Lance Pattern
recipe.description: A citadel field pattern for upgrading a proven spear with void scale and starless bite.

recipe.name: Wyrmhide Wardcoat Pattern
recipe.description: A high-risk armoring pattern that stitches void scale into a coat strong enough for the final dark.

recipe.name: Concord Seal Band Pattern
recipe.description: A relic jeweler's pattern for harmonizing the world's scattered wards into one charged ring.
